name: LOT VACUUM Co., Ltd.
summary: LOT VACUUM Co., Ltd. focuses on providing comprehensive solutions for dry vacuum pumps, encompassing their design, manufacturing, sales, and repair. These essential pumps find application across various fields, including the semiconductor industry, solar power facilities, plasma equipment, and general maintenance. The company was established by Heung-Shik Oh on March 23, 2002, and is presently headquartered in Osan-si, South Korea.
